data.body:
Carry-over from the engine switch (change 3349, skilled-cepevorous-naga), LLM-Review +1 with 4 ADVISORY findings, deliberately not re-pushed (a new patchset would reset both votes). They concern the interim "agentic not available" raise this story replaces, so handle them here:
1. A DET-passing agentic run's degraded INDETERMINATE is still emitted to the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar; as the newest sidecar it defeats a later pipeline run's BLOCK verdict reuse (one extra full review). Once the agentic arm exists, decide the sidecar policy for agentic verdicts explicitly.
2. The interim raise reaches the generic LLM-outage path (coverage.llm_unavailable=True), so an engine choice reads like a provider outage. Removing the raise removes this; the post-dispatch-tail skip in _run_plan_review keys on engine != "pipeline" AND llm_unavailable, so revisit that condition when the agentic arm returns real verdicts (the pipeline Pass-3 floors/xcheck/fix-unit grouping must not run on agentic findings unless intended).
3. No direct test of the tail-skip condition itself (it is covered indirectly: test_drift_refresh_runs_only_under_pipeline failed with a drift-floor novelty call before the skip existed).
4. plan_review_engine_route's unknown-engine ValueError and empty-engine fallback branches are untested (unreachable through review_plan, which validates first).
